split.name: fixed-evaluation
split.method: Twelve CivitAI nsfwLevel=X records selected by ascending SHA-256(seed + filename), followed by six licensed Commons photos, six licensed ordinary illustrations, and the existing user-reported false positive. No model tuning uses these cases.

labelPolicy.yes: CivitAI dataset nsfwLevel=X. This is a source-provided NSFW level, not an independent human claim that every image depicts a sex act or pornography.
labelPolicy.no: Ordinary subject matter in the cited licensed photo/illustration, or the user-reported false-positive label for the existing local fixture.
labelPolicy.drawingRule: A drawing is not positive merely because it is drawn. All six ordinary illustration controls are labeled no; X-level content is positive from the dataset label, not from its medium.

models.name: MobileNetV4 Conv Small NSFW classifier
models.preprocessing: RGB; timm input_size 224; resize shorter side to round(224 / 0.875) = 256, center-crop 224, bicubic resampling; scale [0,1], then normalize by mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
